title: C21: first close under the lower Bollinger band in a falling band, short to the mid

what.name: Pierce
what.value_plain: first close below BB(20,2) lower band, mid falling, no pierce in the prior 10 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: Breakdown context
what.value_plain: the close is a new 14-day low
what.label: OURS

what.name: Exit
what.value_plain: first close back above the BB mid (or RSI under 30 then back over its SMA 14)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: bb_lower_pierce_breakdown.py, Binance spot 15m from 2022 (30m and 4h built from it).
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: LEAD only: 30m breakdown pierces positive in both periods (+0.16% / +0.62%) but n 38/35 among many cells.

why: 15m breakdown pierces fall about 0.9% further (median) but the mid exit gives it back: -0.06% / -0.20%.
Pierces that are not a new 2-week low lose on 15m and 30m.
Needs one pre-registered 30m test before it counts.
